svg.aria-label: Lint and format: Biome 2.5 (D-06). Run pnpm format before a commit. TypeScript 6.0.3 for now: The SDK core moves to TS 7 when it starts. Node 24: Runs the .ts scripts directly (type stripping). No tsx needed. Unit tests: Live in tests/unit/. Run pnpm test. Blueprint: Shared CI and templates: synthwerk-blueprint (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-blueprint). Reference: The full layout, fonts, logo and roadmap are in docs/REFERENCE.md
